userText:
Building: Gare de Lyon, Paris (railway station).
The front (−z) is the station front on the Place Louis-Armand.
Footprint: 180.9 m along x by 221.1 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-90.1,106.6],[-90.4,85.6],[-86.6,47],[-25.2,-81.7],[-5.9,-101.9],[1.2,-106],[89.1,-110.5],[90.4,-91.8],[90.4,109.4],[6,110.5]]
Height: the highest point is 67 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the forecourt: long Beaux-Arts facade with arches, mansard roofs and the tall clock tower, daylight
  2. high view looking down along the station's train shed roofs and tracks
  3. view of the long arcaded facade and mansard roof from the other end, tower out of frame, daylight

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: Gare de Lyon: a long cream Beaux-Arts station front with a rusticated arcaded ground floor, pilastered upper storey and grey mansard roof with dormers, along the −z street side. A tall clock tower with a grey dome stands at the +x end of the front. Behind, long barrel-vaulted glass and metal train sheds run along z, flanked on the east by a long punched-window office wing.
